mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE MoM > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when RSAFS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO MoM < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs month-over-month signals economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when PAYEMS MoM > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 10% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% month-over-month, it signals a strong demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances when HOUST MoM > 10% and UNRATE MoM < -0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a decrease in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month coupled with an increase in Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals stagflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances when INDPRO MoM < -1% and CPIAUCSL MoM > 0.5% during late-cycle expansion.
